archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.2 Conduct Research and Proof-of-Concepts
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Next, ideas must be tested safely. In this step, small teams run experiments, PoCs, or pilot studies. They try out a new imputation method, a new AI-based classification, a new data ingestion pattern, or a new statistical package. The work is exploratory, but not chaotic. Scope, success criteria, and risks are defined upfront. Security and privacy rules still apply. The goal is simple: Does this work for us? If yes — continue. If no — document and stop.
Value created: Evidence about what works and what does not, based on real tests — not assumptions.
